messages:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: Pager 'stack-router-heartbeat' fired (sev: P3) — 12% 5m error rate spike, autosuppress window=60s, group=router-proxy :rotating_light:
Akash R: acked. I'm on it. any hit to customers seen?
SRE Oncall: thx akash. I see the alert, pulling metrics now.
Akash R: quick look at dashboards: a short qps bump from canary traffic around the same time, error type '502 backend fetch'.
Maria G: pinging infra team since backend fetches point to egress pool saturating? cc @Julie T
Julie T: saw a couple of kernel drops on the egress nodes 3m ago, but nothing that should cause 502 at that level. digging.
IncidentBot: PagerDuty: page 'stack-router-heartbeat' auto-resolved (duration 45s) — reason: metric back to baseline.
Akash R: interesting — auto-resolved. did PD escalate before resolve?
SRE Oncall: no escalation, no manual ack from rotation besides the ack. PD didn't send SMS. looks like a transient flap.
Maria G: still want to confirm customer impact. any customer errors or support tickets?
Support Bot: scanning for inbound support tickets: none in last 60m referencing degraded responses or errors for router-proxy services.
Akash R: logs: I pulled proxied request samples, many are retries with short TTL; some 502s correlate with a spike of backend connect timeouts ~1.2s.
Julie T: I restarted egress proxy on node-e-7 as a quick mitigation (low risk). monitoring.
SRE Oncall: noting timeline: 00:00 alert fired, 00:30 ack, 00:45 auto-resolve, 02:00 minor recurrence (another brief firing).
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: Pager 'stack-router-heartbeat' fired (sev: P3) — recurrence.
Akash R: acked again. I saw the second blip, same error class. this one was 18s and auto-resolved.
Maria G: ok, two quick flaps. I'm going to take handoff — need someone to watch for a 3rd fire before we escalate. @SRE Oncall please add to the oncall notes and mark as noisy flapping alert.
SRE Oncall: added note: "noisy/flapping - transient 502 spike, likely egress contention; automated auto-resolve twice; no customer reports."
Julie T: infra: we saw a correlated short-lived mem pressure on node-e-7 ~00:40 which matches the first event. increasing ephemeral pool size by 10% for the group to reduce risk. change rolled at 01:10 UTC.
Akash R: can we reduce noise? current alert thresholds are 5m rolling rate >10% to trigger. maybe a short cooldown or require sustained 2/5m?
Maria G: agree. propose: increase threshold to 15% or require 2/5m windows. I'll file a quick alert tuning PR and link runbook.
SRE Oncall: also proposing to add a KV warmup check to the alert to avoid transient coldstart noise for canary traffic.
IncidentBot: Note: PagerDuty suppression policy applied for this group (30m) due to rapid flapping — no further pages to rotation within window.
Akash R: good. I'll keep watching logs for any pattern. leaving a short query for future postmortem.
Support Bot: customer-facing note draft: "We briefly observed transient proxy errors in service; automatic recovery occurred and we saw no customer impact. Engineering is monitoring and tuning alerts." anyone want to adjust wording?
Julie T: fine by me.
Maria G: looks good. I'll merge the alert tuning PR and add the infra mitigation summary.
SRE Oncall: marking thread closed from an oncall perspective. reopen if pages continue or customer reports arrive. :white_check_mark:
Akash R: thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
Maria G: filing follow-up ticket #ENG-5321 for durable fix and runbook updates.
IncidentBot: thread archived (auto).
